anchors.description: The room's territory. Each anchor is either a path prefix ("src/auth", matched on whole path segments, covering that path and everything under it) or a single source segment id as `vh.mjs source segment` emits it ("docs/prd.md#fork-flow", "src/app.html#L120-179"), covering that segment and no other. The "#" is the discriminator. Both forms name a set of segments, and two rooms where neither contains the other must not name intersecting sets.

anchor_hashes.description: One entry per anchored unit. A path-prefix anchor contributes one entry per file it covers, where "path" is the file path and "blob" is git's blob hash. A segment anchor contributes exactly one entry, where "path" is the segment id and "blob" is the SHA-1 of that segment's bytes — so the room drifts when the anchored segment's bytes change and stays fresh when only other parts of the same file change.

coverage_exceptions.description: Segments of this room's anchored sources that deliberately yield no Context, each with a stated reason. Declared by the room that owns the anchor, but read repository-wide, exactly as citations are: an exception is a statement about a segment, not about a room, so it settles that segment's count wherever the segment is counted and never has to be copied into a second room that also anchors part of the same file. Optional: rooms written before this field existed remain valid.
